verification_policy: Single-skill Strike Super research: independently reconcile Xenoverse 2 identity, acquisition route, cost, and mechanics. Preserve unresolved stamina/version-sensitive fields as null or descriptive text.
research_scope: Super Dragon Fist — Strike Super acquisition and mechanics research.

verification_audit.method: Compared repository exact-name search results and seeded Strike Super membership with current Xenoverse 2-specific and independent Dragon Ball documentation.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No existing repository research batch for Super Dragon Fist was found. The canonical identity is Super / Strike. It is kept distinct from the Strike Ultimate Dragon Fist.
duplicate_check.variant_note: Super Dragon Fist and Dragon Fist are separate Xenoverse 2 skills; the former is the Super Skill and the latter is the Strike Ultimate.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Xenoverse 2 documentation classifies Super Dragon Fist as a Strike Super Attack.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Independent Xenoverse 2 documentation states that the Future Warrior can obtain Super Dragon Fist from the Conton City Skill Shop. Historical launch-era community reports also identify the Skill Shop route.
verification_audit.finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required remains null because the documented acquisition route is Skill Shop rather than a Parallel Quest reward.
verification_audit.cost_policy: The reviewed sources establish the Strike Super identity and Skill Shop route but do not provide a sufficiently reliable current canonical Ki value in the sources used for this batch; ki_cost and stamina_cost therefore remain null rather than importing an unsupported number.

records.name: Super Dragon Fist
records.skill_description: A short Strike Super rush using a rapid series of Dragon Fist-style punches against the opponent.
records.mechanics_notes: Super Dragon Fist is the Super Skill counterpart to the separate Dragon Fist Strike Ultimate. The reviewed sources confirm its Strike Super classification and distinguish it from the Ultimate; exact frame, hit-count, and damage details are not promoted to canonical numeric fields without stronger current evidence.
records.acquisition_notes: The Future Warrior can obtain Super Dragon Fist through the Conton City Skill Shop. Historical launch-era reports independently describe it appearing in the Skill Shop, supporting the current acquisition route.
records.pve_notes: Skill Shop acquisition; no Parallel Quest or Ultimate Finish requirement established.
records.pvp_notes: Close-range Strike Super/rush; detailed frame and matchup behavior remains version-sensitive and is intentionally left descriptive.
